text: create a vehicle handling lab, this will be the first introduction of driving vehicles in the game engine
resolution: Built the vehicle handling lab as the FIRST driving model in the engine. Corrected course mid-build: it lives in the editor's labs route (cart/hmsc-int/labs/vehicle-handling.tsx, registered via rjit lab new — the first lab there), NOT a standalone cart. New game system GAME_DRIVING (cart/hmsc-int/game/driving/) is a pure React-free kinematic bicycle model (engine/brake/drag longitudinal, exp-decay lateral grip → drift, speed-scaled heading turn that reverses correctly); cart-side per DECISIONS V1 to find the feel before graduating to the one host physics system, exposed via the @game door. The lab drives a real GAME_VEHICLE body around a cone slalom, V23 native chase camera (GAME_NATIVE_CAMERA orbit, since V26 bans JS viewport cameras on lab surfaces), GAME_INPUT keys (WASD/arrows + space handbrake), GAME_LOOP frame clock. Left panel is a tunable feel bench (engine/top-speed/brake/grip/steer/drag/cam-dist) + body picker (sedan/sports/pickup/van/police/fire truck, wheelbase feeds turn radius); HUD shows km/h, gear, slip. Verified: both new files transform clean and the lab bundles with full @game+runtime resolution (792KB). Paired P6 notes + game/driving CAPTURE.md included.
